info.title: Linear
info.description: Linear is a modern issue tracking and project management tool for software teams. Create, update, query, and search issues in your Linear workspace.

post.description: Retrieves all teams in the Linear workspace.

query.default: query { teams { nodes { id name key description color } } }

200.description: Successful response with list of teams.

key.description: Short key prefix for issue identifiers (e.g., ENG).

post.description: Retrieves workflow states (statuses) for the workspace.

query.default: query { workflowStates { nodes { id name type color position team { id name } } } }

200.description: Successful response with list of workflow states.

name.description: State display name (e.g., Backlog, In Progress, Done).

type.description: State category: backlog, unstarted, started, completed, or canceled.

position.description: Sort position within the team workflow.

post.description: Retrieves all users in the Linear workspace.

query.default: query { users { nodes { id name displayName email active admin } } }

200.description: Successful response with list of users.

active.description: Whether the user account is active.

admin.description: Whether the user is a workspace admin.

post.description: Retrieves all issue labels in the Linear workspace.

query.default: query { issueLabels { nodes { id name description color parent { id name } } } }

200.description: Successful response with list of labels.

id.description: Parent label identifier for grouped labels.

post.description: Creates a new issue in a Linear team.

query.default: mutation CreateIssue($teamId: String!, $title: String!, $description: String, $stateId: String, $assigneeId: String, $priority: Int, $dueDate: TimelessDate, $estimate: Int, $labelIds: [String!]) { issueCreate(input: { teamId: $teamId, title: $title, description: $description, stateId: $stateId, assigneeId: $assigneeId, priority: $priority, dueDate: $dueDate, estimate: $estimate, labelIds: $labelIds }) { success issue { id identifier title description url createdAt priority state { id name } assignee { id name } team { id name key } labels { nodes { id name } } } } }

teamId.description: Team where the issue will be created.

stateId.description: Workflow state. Defaults to the team Backlog state if omitted.

assigneeId.description: User to assign the issue to.

labelIds.description: Array of label IDs to apply. Get IDs from List Labels.

success.description: Whether the issue was created successfully.

url.description: Direct URL to the issue in Linear.

post.description: Retrieves a single issue by its UUID or human-readable identifier (e.g., ENG-42).

query.default: query GetIssue($id: String!) { issue(id: $id) { id identifier title description url createdAt updatedAt dueDate estimate priority state { id name type } assignee { id name email } creator { id name } team { id name key } labels { nodes { id name color } } } }

id.description: Issue UUID or human-readable identifier (e.g., ENG-42).

url.description: Direct URL to the issue in Linear.

post.description: Lists issues sorted by last updated time. Supports pagination.

query.default: query ListIssues($first: Int, $after: String) { issues(first: $first, after: $after, orderBy: updatedAt) { nodes { id identifier title url createdAt updatedAt priority state { id name type } assignee { id name } team { id name key } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

first.description: Number of issues to return. Default 50, max 100.

after.description: Pagination cursor. Use endCursor from a previous response.

200.description: Successful response with list of issues.

url.description: Direct URL to the issue in Linear.

hasNextPage.description: Whether more results exist beyond this page.

endCursor.description: Cursor to pass as after parameter for the next page.

post.description: Updates properties of an existing issue.

query.default: mutation UpdateIssue($id: String!, $title: String, $description: String, $stateId: String, $assigneeId: String, $priority: Int, $dueDate: TimelessDate, $estimate: Int, $labelIds: [String!]) { issueUpdate(id: $id, input: { title: $title, description: $description, stateId: $stateId, assigneeId: $assigneeId, priority: $priority, dueDate: $dueDate, estimate: $estimate, labelIds: $labelIds }) { success issue { id identifier title description url updatedAt priority state { id name } assignee { id name } team { id name key } } } }

id.description: UUID of the issue to update.

stateId.description: New workflow state for the issue.

dueDate.description: New due date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

labelIds.description: New label IDs (replaces all existing labels).

url.description: Direct URL to the issue in Linear.

post.description: Creates a comment on an existing issue.

query.default: mutation AddComment($issueId: String!, $body: String!) { commentCreate(input: { issueId: $issueId, body: $body }) { success comment { id body createdAt user { id name } issue { id identifier } } } }

issueId.description: UUID of the issue to comment on.

success.description: Whether the comment was created successfully.

post.description: Searches issues by text across titles and descriptions.

query.default: query SearchIssues($searchText: String!, $first: Int, $after: String) { searchIssues(term: $searchText, first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id identifier title description url createdAt updatedAt priority state { id name type } assignee { id name } team { id name key } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

searchText.description: Text to search for across issue titles and descriptions.

first.description: Number of results to return. Default 50, max 100.

after.description: Pagination cursor. Use endCursor from a previous response.

url.description: Direct URL to the issue in Linear.

hasNextPage.description: Whether more results exist beyond this page.

endCursor.description: Cursor to pass as after parameter for the next page.
